summary: Site 171 has one MetroCount tube counter (173) that has run continuously since April 2021. Its data is clean, with one record per slot and balanced directions, and it rises for real events such as the September 2022 UCI Road World Championships. The automatic fixes are sound, including the single all-even day halved on 2022-02-19 and the warning outages. Only the failing days around the August 2022 outage need to be set to missing.
